text_block_list.text:
The day of the Sprinters Stakes—the second 
sprint GⅠ we had set our sights on—finally 
arrived.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
This race is a 1,200m sprint, shorter than 
a mile!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
In other words, that means I can burn 
rubber even harder than usual, YES?!

On top of that, Nakayama Racecourse has a 
steep hill right before the finish line, 
requiring plenty of power...
